WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg
  FROM signals
),
kept AS (
  SELECT s.rfistat, s.avg_modindex, b.overall_avg
  FROM status_averages AS s
  CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
  WHERE s.avg_modindex > b.overall_avg
)
SELECT rfistat,
       avg_modindex,
       avg_modindex - overall_avg AS above_baseline,
       avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM kept;
